author: FoxNFrags
quote: 12 hours in, no bs. Won’t lie, graphics are stunning. Gun play is pretty cool. Driving takes a second to get used to, but once you get it down it great and car customization is super cool. But here’s where things get questionable. Why am I being penalized in a game about crime for committing crime? What’s with this honor system? And Lucia has to be *so far* one of the most annoying characters in the game. Donnie was cool, Cal is funny, but like, nothing that Lucia does makes me want to really keep her around. And where is the action? I’m only in chapter one but with 12 hours of gameplay and only 3 big shootouts, that seems a bit wild to me. Great game, but if I’m being completely honest this shouldn’t have a gta title. If anything from what I’ve played, it should have been a red dead title. Maybe it picks up later, but so far this is what time getting.
